1.finding: The adopted ordinary IPS route without Arabic allocates 180 EC. Current FTR-RSBA307 requires knowledge of Buddhism and Hinduism, while current first-year FTR-RTIBA101 describes comparative world religions without identifying those traditions. The separate Hinduism and Buddhism course in RPS does not establish an IPS bridge. The official-domain search found no syllabus, reading list or progression rule establishing the necessary background.

The current OSIRIS module states required prior knowledge of Buddhism and Hinduism. The ordinary route does not include the separately named Buddhism and Hinduism course listed in RPS. The first-year worldwide religions course discusses several world religions, but the current official module does not name either tradition. The applicable route bridge or satisfactory alternative remains unverified.
